change: Apply the existing 512,000-byte limit to every POST endpoint under /api/v1/spaces/{spaceId}/maps, including map creation, draft save, publish, restore, and collaborative edits. Content-Length requests are rejected before buffering; streaming requests are read only up to the limit plus one byte and rejected with HTTP 413 when oversized.

verification.productionBuild: web, api, world, and media images built sequentially; API and World Gradle builds skipped test tasks per deployment policy

limits: A signed-in editor request was not manually sent at the 512,000-byte boundary; automated tests were omitted per user preference.
dataHandling: No database rows, persistent volumes, production preferences, or environment files were changed.
